newsitem.title: USA: Founders must comprise most of EMU GDP - Schmidhuber.
newsitem.headline: Founders must comprise most of EMU GDP - Schmidhuber.

text.p: European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) must include enough members at the outset to represent the bulk of the union's gross national product, Bundesbank council member Peter Schmidhuber said on Tuesday.
"The states which start phase three of the monetary union must contain a substantial part of the gross national product of the union," Schmidhuber told a conference on EMU in New York.
The German central banker was responding to a question on how many member states are needed in 1999 to make EMU work.
Phase three of the planned monetary union is scheduled to start on January 1, 1999 with the launch of the new single currency, the euro.
